# Find a Park: WTS Breakdown and Agent Prompts

## What gets created on execution

- `PLAN.md` at repo root: this document (waves, tracks, prompts).
- `.cursor/rules/find-a-park.mdc` (alwaysApply): the single context rule every agent reads. Contents listed below.
- `progress.md` at repo root: lifecycle tracker with one pre-seeded block per track.

Assumptions (the scoping questions were skipped, so these are defaults):
- Images: free-licensed photos saved to `public/images/`, `parks.json` paths rewritten (documented in README), and a placeholder fallback for empty or broken images (matches the Highland Dog Park screenshot).
- Tests: Vitest + React Testing Library for data helpers, search filter, and the detail page with missing fields. No Playwright.
- No Linear issues; WTS coordinates live only in this plan since this is a standalone take-home.

## Context rule contents (`.cursor/rules/find-a-park.mdc`)

Derived from the candidate PDF. Keep it under ~80 lines:
1. **Goal**: residents find local parks via map, list, and detail page. 2-hour budget, modest and polished beats ambitious and broken.
2. **Must-haves**: map with markers that link to details; works without geolocation; list usable without the map; detail page shows name, address, description, amenities, hours, images, acreage, rating; phone + desktop; keyboard-selectable list with visible focus ring.
3. **Data rules**: source is `src/data/parks.json` (copy of the sample). Fields may be missing/null, arrays may be empty. Never invent data: show "No rating yet", "No description available", or omit the row. Known gaps: `highland-dog-park` has no address, `cedar-hill-nature-preserve` and `east-ridge-trailhead` have no images, `old-mill-botanical-garden` has null description, `cedar-hill-nature-preserve` has null rating.
4. **Stack**: Vite, React, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind v4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`, tokens in `src/index.css` `@theme`), `react-router-dom`, `react-leaflet` + OpenStreetMap tiles (no API keys), `lucide-react` icons, Vitest + RTL.
5. **Design system**: mobile-first; single breakpoint switch at `md` (768px). Tokens: `primary` (blue-700, buttons and markers), `ink` (slate-900), `muted` (slate-500), `surface` (white), `chip` (slate-100), `star` (amber-400), radius `xl`/`3xl`, focus ring `ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2`.
6. **Layouts** (from screenshots): Home mobile = header "Find a Park", list, "Open map" button toggles full-screen map. Home desktop = full-screen map with floating list panel on the left. Detail mobile = full-bleed hero + rounded bottom-sheet card overlapping. Detail desktop = centered `max-w-3xl` column, rounded hero. "Back to all parks" pill over hero.
7. **Routes**: `/` home, `/park/:id` detail, unknown id shows a friendly not-found with link home.
8. **File ownership map** (copy of the table in "File overlap analysis" below). Agents edit only files their track owns.
9. **Progress protocol**: on start, set your block in `progress.md` to `IN PROGRESS`; on finish, set `DONE`, list files touched, commands run (`npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`) with results, and any follow-ups. Edit only your own block.
10. **Definition of done per track**: lint, tests, and build pass; no edits outside owned files; progress block updated.
11. **Out of scope**: backend, auth, geolocation, deployment, filters beyond text search.
12. **Reminder**: keep the full AI transcript; the human submits it.

```markdown

Current wave: 1
| Track | Status | Owner files | Notes |
```

## Wave map

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  W1T1[W1.T1 Scaffold] --> W2T1[W2.T1 Data layer]
  W1T1 --> W2T2[W2.T2 UI primitives]
  W1T1 --> W2T3[W2.T3 Map component]

  W2T2 --> W3T2
  W3T1 --> W4T1[W4.T1 Search]
  W3T2 --> W4T2[W4.T2 README draft]
  W3T1 --> W4T2
  W4T1 --> W5T1[W5.T1 Verification]
  W4T2 --> W5T1
```

- Wave 1: 1 track (sequential, must finish first).
- Wave 2: 3 tracks run concurrently.
- Wave 3: 2 tracks run concurrently.
- Wave 4: 2 tracks run concurrently.
- Wave 5: 1 track (sequential, final).

## File overlap analysis

- **W1.T1**: `package.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig*.json`, `index.html`, `src/main.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`, `src/index.css`, `src/types/park.ts`, `src/data/parks.json` (initial copy), `src/test/setup.ts`, placeholder `src/pages/HomePage.tsx` + `src/pages/ParkDetailPage.tsx`, `.cursor/rules/find-a-park.mdc`, `progress.md`, `PLAN.md`.
- **W2.T1**: `src/data/parks.ts`, `src/data/parks.test.ts`, `src/lib/format.ts`, `src/data/parks.json` (image paths only), `public/images/*`.
- **W2.T2**: `src/components/ui/*` (`StarRating`, `ParkImage`, `BackLink`, `InfoRow`, `AmenityChip`, `Placeholder`), `src/lib/amenities.ts`.
- **W2.T3**: `src/components/map/ParkMap.tsx`, `src/components/map/ParkPopup.tsx`.
- **W3.T1**: `src/pages/HomePage.tsx`, `src/components/park-list/*`.
- **W3.T2**: `src/pages/ParkDetailPage.tsx`, `src/components/park-detail/*`, `src/pages/ParkDetailPage.test.tsx`.
- **W4.T1**: `src/lib/filterParks.ts`, `src/lib/filterParks.test.ts`, `src/components/search/SearchInput.tsx`, `src/pages/HomePage.tsx`, `src/components/park-list/ParkListPanel.tsx`.
- **W4.T2**: `README.md` only.
- **W5.T1**: any file (fixes only), `README.md` finalize.

Result: no file is owned by two tracks in the same wave. `App.tsx` routes are registered once in W1 so later tracks never touch it. W4.T1 edits `HomePage.tsx` only after W3.T1 has finished.

Runtime-surface check: each route has exactly one writer (W3.T1 owns `/`, W3.T2 owns `/park/:id`). The home-page map region is written by W3.T1 and then by W4.T1 in a later wave. Search wins by design: it feeds filtered parks into the same `ParkMap` and list. No unresolved shared surfaces.

## Agent prompts

Every prompt starts with the same header:

> Read `.cursor/rules/find-a-park.mdc` and `progress.md` first. You are track **{ID}**. Only edit the files listed under "You own". Mark your block IN PROGRESS now, and DONE with notes when finished. Run `npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` before marking DONE.

### W1.T1 Scaffold (run alone)
Create a Vite React-TS app in the repo root. Install `tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite react-router-dom react-leaflet leaflet lucide-react` and dev deps `@types/leaflet vitest @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom jsdom`. Configure Tailwind v4 tokens from the rule in `src/index.css`. Add `src/types/park.ts` (`Park` with optional/nullable fields matching the sample). Copy the sample JSON to `src/data/parks.json`. In `src/App.tsx` register routes `/` and `/park/:id` with a catch-all, using placeholder pages. Add npm scripts `lint`, `test`, `build`. Create `.cursor/rules/find-a-park.mdc`, `progress.md`, and `PLAN.md` from this plan. You own: the W1.T1 file list.

### W2.T1 Data layer (concurrent with W2.T2, W2.T3)
Implement `src/data/parks.ts`: `getParks()` (sorted by name) and `getParkById(id)` returning `Park | undefined`, normalizing null/missing fields to `undefined` and empty arrays. Implement `src/lib/format.ts`: `formatAcreage`, `formatRating` ("4.4 / 5" or "No rating yet"), `hasAddress`. Download free-licensed photos for parks that have images into `public/images/{id}-{n}.jpg` and rewrite only the `images` arrays in `parks.json`. Leave empty arrays empty. Write `parks.test.ts` covering each known data gap. You own: the W2.T1 file list.

### W2.T2 UI primitives (concurrent)
Build presentational components in `src/components/ui/` that take primitive props only (no data imports): `StarRating` (half stars, `aria-label="Rated 4.4 out of 5"`, renders nothing if no rating), `ParkImage` (falls back to `Placeholder` mountain illustration on empty src or `onError`), `BackLink` (white pill with chevron, router `Link`), `InfoRow` (label + value), `AmenityChip` (icon + label). Add `src/lib/amenities.ts` mapping amenity slugs to label + lucide icon, with a title-cased fallback for unknown slugs. All interactive elements get the focus ring token. You own: the W2.T2 file list.

### W2.T3 Map component (concurrent)
Build `ParkMap` with `react-leaflet`: props `parks: Park[]`, `className?`. OSM tile layer with attribution. Render `CircleMarker` in `primary` (no default icon asset issues). Fit bounds to the parks, with a sensible NYC fallback center when the list is empty. On marker click, open `ParkPopup`, which shows the name, the address if present, and a "View details" `Link` to `/park/:id`. Import `leaflet/dist/leaflet.css`. Must work with no geolocation. Give the map container an `aria-label`. You own: the W2.T3 file list.

### W3.T1 Home page (concurrent with W3.T2)
Build `HomePage` and `src/components/park-list/` (`ParkList`, `ParkListItem`, `ParkListPanel`). Each list item is a router `Link` with a thumbnail (`ParkImage`), name, address (omitted if missing), and chevron, plus a visible focus ring. Mobile (below `md`): header "Find a Park", list, and an "Open map" button that toggles a full-screen `ParkMap` with a "Show list" button. Desktop (`md` and up): full-viewport `ParkMap` with a floating rounded left panel containing the list (scrollable). Reserve an empty slot above the list for search (filled in W4). ### W3.T2 Detail page (concurrent)
Build `ParkDetailPage` and `src/components/park-detail/` (`ParkHero`, `ParkInfoList`, `AmenityGrid`, `PhotoGallery`). Use `getParkById`; if not found, show "Park not found" with a link home. Mobile: full-bleed hero, `BackLink` overlaid, and a content card with `rounded-t-3xl -mt-6` and a drag-handle bar. Desktop: centered `max-w-3xl` with a rounded hero. Show the name (h1), address, `StarRating`, description or "No description available", info rows (Address, Hours, Size, Rating), amenity grid, and photos (hidden if none). Set `document.title`. Test with Cedar Hill (no images, no rating) and Old Mill (no description). You own: the W3.T2 file list.

### W4.T1 Search (concurrent with W4.T2)
Add `filterParks(parks, query)`: case-insensitive match on name, address, and amenity labels; trimmed; empty query returns all. Add tests. Build `SearchInput` (labelled, search icon, clear button, `type="search"`). In `HomePage`, keep the query in the URL (`?q=`) so going back from details preserves it. Feed the filtered parks to both the list and `ParkMap`. Show the count "Find a Park (4 of 12)" while filtering, and an empty state "No parks match" with a clear action. You own: the W4.T1 file list.

### W4.T2 README draft (concurrent)
Draft `README.md` per the PDF: run instructions, what works, what was left out, key decisions (stack, no keys, CircleMarkers, URL search state, data changes to image paths), known issues, how it was checked, time spent, next steps before public use, and a note about AI logs. Leave a "Verification results" section for W5. You own: `README.md`.

### W5.T1 Verification pass (run alone)
Run lint, tests, and build. Manually check at 375px and 1280px widths. Use only the keyboard to tab from the list to a detail page and back, confirming the focus ring is visible. Check every park's detail page for crashes or invented data. Check that search filters both the list and the markers. Fix issues with minimal edits, record findings in the README "Verification results" section, and set "Current wave: complete" in `progress.md`.

## Rollback

Each track is small enough to revert by discarding its owned files (`git checkout -- <files>`). W1 is the only track whose rollback blocks everything else.

# Find a Park: WTS Breakdown and Agent Prompts

Break the Find a Park take-home (Vite + React + TS + Tailwind + react-leaflet) into small agent-sized tracks organized by Wave / Track / Sequence. Every agent reads one shared context rule and updates `progress.md`. File ownership is disjoint inside each wave, so tracks in the same wave can run concurrently.

## Project files

- `PLAN.md` (this file): waves, tracks, prompts.
- `.cursor/rules/find-a-park.mdc` (alwaysApply): the single context rule every agent reads.
- `progress.md`: lifecycle tracker with one block per track.
- `src/data/parks.json`: the sample with `images` rewritten to Wikimedia Commons URLs (created in W1.T1, see "Image sourcing").

Assumptions:
- Images: hotlinked Wikimedia Commons URLs (no downloads, no keys). Exactly one park (`highland-dog-park`) keeps `"images": []` to exercise the empty case. `ParkImage` still falls back to a placeholder when a URL fails to load.
- Icons: `lucide-react` is the only icon library. Do not add `react-icons` or any other icon package.
- Tests: Vitest + React Testing Library for data helpers, search filter, and the detail page with missing fields. No Playwright. Lint/test/build run once, in W5.T1.
- No Linear issues; WTS coordinates live only in this plan since this is a standalone take-home.

## How to run this plan

1. Run each track prompt in its own agent chat. Tracks in the same wave can run at the same time.
2. Review each finished track and run the app locally.
3. For each accepted track, run the commit prompt in a separate chat, one at a time.
4. Start the next wave only when every track in the current wave is committed.
